text: Angles of Displacement: Ger. Erhebungswinkel und Seitenwendungswinkel ( des Blickes ); Fr. angle ascensionnel du regard et angle de déplacement latéral ( de l'oeil ); Ital. angoli di spostamento visuale . The angles of vertical and lateral displacement (see DONDERS' LAW) are used by Helmholtz to determine the direction of the line of regard. The former measures the departure of the plane of regard, upwards or downwards, from the primary position; the latter is the angle made by the present line of regard with the median line of the plane of regard. Literature : HELMHOLTZ, Physiol. Optik (2nd ed.), 617. ( E.B.T .)
